title: Meta's new Muse Charm device may cost $300 | TechCrunch
summary: Meta plans to charge $300 for Muse Charm, its upcoming Tamagotchi-like AI device that was teased at the company’s Connect event earlier this year, The Information has reported . It remains to be seen whether customers will bite or not.
